mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz (type_id, title, category_id, content, explanation, created_at) VALUES (#{educationType}, #{educationTitle}, #{educationCategoryID}, #{educationContent}, #{educationExplanation}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO answer_option (quiz_id, content, is_correct, option_number) VALUES
(#{educationId}, #{option.optionContents}, #{option.correct}, #{option.orderingNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName FROM quiz_category

SELECT q.quiz_id AS educationId, q.type_id AS educationType, q.category_id AS educationCategoryID, q.title AS educationTitle, q.content AS educationContent, q.explanation AS educationExplanation, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM member_quiz_history mqh INNER JOIN quiz q ON q.quiz_id = mqh.quiz_id WHERE mqh.member_id = #{memberId} AND mqh.created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT q.quiz_id AS educationId, q.type_id AS educationType, q.category_id AS educationCategoryID, q.title AS educationTitle, q.content AS educationContent, q.explanation AS educationExplanation, q.created_at AS createdAt FROM quiz q WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_quiz_history mqh WHERE mqh.member_id = #{memberId} AND mqh.quiz_id = q.quiz_id )
